TC-11/S09.title: Nursing Home ledger rules: the two 'Save Note again' cells and the hand-typed unnumbered line
TC-11/S09.detail: Our addition (review TFA-92589). rst-tc11-s09-resave.spec.ts, local, parsePreRoundNotes answered at the socket. (1) NH: Visit 1 finished, a revisit's Pre-Round Save Note appended 'Visit 2 · Oct 16: Fall after lunch, no injury.'; Save Note again -> still two lines, 'Visit 2 · Oct 16: Fall after lunch, no injury; hip films ordered.', no Visit 3, Visit 1 unchanged (judged, pass). (2) Hospital: today's pending line, then Save Note again -> one line 'Oct 16: Fall after lunch, no injury; hip films ordered. ⏳ Encounter pending.' (judged, pass; the corrected content is Q9, recorded). (3) NH: Visit 1 finished + the hand-typed unnumbered line 'Family meeting held, goals of care reviewed', then a new Pre-Round -> the build writes 'Visit 3 · Oct 16: …' (Q13 expects Visit 2; recorded only, never judged). The table's other cells are Tim's course-timeline titles (they store a note with the default template, so on 25acd727 they cannot run locally; not part of this package's re-run). Tripwire: no model call.
